propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures inflate test setup time by materializing 3,019 files; a minimal committed Hatch package fixture with production hatch_build.py preserves exact fallback SHA while reducing paired totals from 6.30–9.26s to 2.66–5.43s.

Live run 31874837464 received patchset 9aecb53e but artifact-probe built with workflow GITHUB_SHA 7d908fb, causing truthiness-only probes to accept wrong nonempty COMMIT and violate ducal-statuelike-ladybird exact-source identity contract.

Runtime -n 3 --dist worksteal assigned three built_artifacts consumers to separate workers, each paying 6.60–6.74s setup; replacing whole-tree fixtures with one shared minimal fixture reduces per-worker setup to 2.20–2.88s (56–67% lower).

Artifact workflow lanes must compute REBAR_EXPECTED_COMMIT using git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout and enforce exact equality for both installed wheel and sdist; this prevents mismatch between patchset checkout and build reference SHA.

All hook-semantics tests must eliminate _clean_tree, _self_contained_checkout, and inline git-archive materialization in favor of one shared fixture that runs production hatch_build.py on a minimal committed package through isolated PEP 517.

Negative controls (wrong nonempty SHA, blank env failure, no-git fallback to None, shallow-source support) and all existing assertions, selectors, workers, platforms, coverage, and vote dependencies must remain invariant.
